title: 4 Space Facts That Will Break Your Brain

scenes.text: We have mapped the entire Moon, but space keeps getting stranger the deeper we look. Here are four facts that will genuinely break your brain.
Number four. A single day on Venus lasts longer than its entire year. The planet spins that slowly.
Number three. Neutron stars spin seven hundred times every single second. One teaspoon of their matter weighs four billion tons.
Number two. Near the center of our galaxy floats a giant cloud that smells like rum, and tastes like raspberries.
And number one. Astronomers found a planet that may be mostly diamond, orbiting a dead star, and it is five times the size of Earth.
And here is the scary part. We have explored less than one percent of our own galaxy. Imagine what is still hiding out there. Follow for more space secrets.
